title: Bitter Pop: A Low-Proof Holiday Highball
ldName: Bitter Pop: A Low-Proof Holiday Highball
ldInstructionsRaw: Add the first 2 ingredients to a glass and top with ginger ale (to create an aromatic foam, pour the ginger ale from a few inches above the glass). Add ice, and garnish. (Optional: Using a kitchen torch, carefully sear the orange slice before using as garnish.)
